new_destinations.coordinates_source: approx. middle of the island's kept spots; pending resolve-pin.py / OSM place=island

name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage has a Tongatapu page with Understand/See/Do listings covering Nukuʻalofa and the whole island
Tonga's tourism board lists Tongatapu as one of its islands

new_destinations.reason: Ten kept places on one island (spot bar of four cleared); Tongatapu is the named region, Nukuʻalofa is the capital base and a spot of it (COVERAGE.md: prefer the region travellers name). Not filed under a bigger city. Writing (description, reasons, tips, header) done by the run.

spots.name: Ha'amonga 'a Maui
spots.bio: A coral-limestone trilithon near Niutoua in the north-east, Tonga's best-known ancient monument.
spots.coordinates_source: pending resolve-pin.py; provisional from wikipedia:Haʻamonga ʻa Maui
spots.reason: Main archaeological landmark; 2 counted sources, 11083 views.

spots.name: Ancient Royal Tombs of Lapaha
spots.bio: Terraced langi tombs of the Tuʻi Tonga kings near Muʻa, with information signs at the site.
spots.coordinates_source: pending resolve-pin.py; provisional from wikivoyage listing geo tag (Tongatapu page)
spots.reason: The langi are the attraction; the Muʻa village entry is dropped as a near-duplicate wrapper (owner brief).

spots.name: Nukuʻalofa
spots.bio: Tonga's capital on the north coast, with its waterfront, churches, markets and most of the island's accommodation.
spots.reason: Town with its own draws (waterfront, royal sights from outside, markets); the island's base.

spots.name: Hufangalupe
spots.bio: A limestone land bridge over a sinkhole on the south-east coast, with viewpoints around the crater.
spots.reason: Natural sight on the south-east coast.

spots.name: Mapu 'a Vaea
spots.bio: Coral-reef blowholes near Houma on the south-west coast, best viewed at high tide.
spots.coordinates_source: pending resolve-pin.py; provisional from wikivoyage listing geo tag (Tongatapu page)
spots.reason: Natural sight on the west-coast route.

spots.name: Anahulu Caves
spots.bio: Partly flooded limestone caves with freshwater pools, visited on guided tours with an optional swim.
spots.coordinates_source: pending resolve-pin.py; provisional from wikivoyage listing geo tag (Tongatapu page)
spots.reason: Guided cave swim; Matatahi 'Anahulu Beach rejected as its near-duplicate.

spots.name: Talamahu Market
spots.bio: Nukuʻalofa's main daily produce market, with carvings, tapa and jewellery in the handicraft hall upstairs.
spots.coordinates_source: pending resolve-pin.py; provisional from wikivoyage listing geo tag (Tongatapu page)
spots.reason: Daily market hall (not a weekly market).

spots.name: Pangaimotu Island
spots.bio: A small island off Nukuʻalofa with a wreck to snorkel, a restaurant and gear hire, reached by boat.
spots.reason: Island day trip from Nukuʻalofa; the island is the spot, the boat is the way there.

spots.name: Flying Fox Reserve
spots.bio: A colony of flying foxes (fruit bats) roosting in the trees at Kolovai village on the western side of the island.
spots.coordinates_source: pending resolve-pin.py (no point found; OSM/agency point needed)
spots.reason: Roadside wildlife stop (Lonely Planet, Tonga Pocket Guide).

spots.name: Haʻatafu Beach
spots.bio: A long white-sand beach with palms and coral on the north-western peninsula, good for snorkelling and sunsets.
spots.coordinates_source: pending resolve-pin.py; provisional from wikivoyage listing geo tag (Tongatapu page)

dropped_kept.reason: Town wrapper beside its own attraction (Ancient Royal Tombs of Lapaha); only the tombs kept, per owner brief and blind-audit review.

notes: No existing Tonga destinations or spots. Ids: destination id 'tongatapu' and 'tongatapu-1..14' appeared on the unmerged tonga-test history, so new spot ids start at tongatapu-21.
